title: Journal v2: schema-validated, indexed, replayable event log
summary: The journal stops being a loose JSONL buffer and becomes a versioned, schema-validated event log. Events gain a typed envelope (actor kind, work item, change, cost) and a fixed set of payloads; every append is validated against a checked-in JSON Schema before a byte is written, and a run-complete event must name the current chain head. The chain hash now covers the whole event, while a second digest — the replay digest — covers only the decision fields, so two runs of the same decisions still agree. Journals move from `<state>/buffer` to `<state>/runs`, a per-work-item index records which runs belong to which item under a file lock, and a reader replays a run end to end, refusing a broken chain rather than returning a partial list.

nodes.label: Checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: osf verify --checkpoint
nodes.summary: Runs the checkpoint's moon tasks and writes one verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event. Now builds an `Actor::system("osf")` and fills the new `check_type`, `summary` and typed `EvidenceGrade` fields.

nodes.label: Review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run.rs
nodes.summary: Writes review-answer events per reviewer and one review-decision event. Updated to pass an `Actor` value rather than a bare string.

nodes.label: Journal writer
nodes.subtitle: Journal::append / append_draft
nodes.summary: Opens `<state>/runs/<run>.jsonl`, validates each draft against the event schema, records the run in its work-item index on the first accepted event, and refuses any event after run-complete. A refused event writes no byte and leaves the chain head unchanged.

nodes.label: Event model
nodes.subtitle: journal/event.rs
nodes.summary: The typed envelope and payloads: `Actor` (harness/person/system), `Cost`, `Change`, `EvidenceGrade`, and ten payload variants including run-started, review, finding, state-change, run-complete and attention.

nodes.label: Hash chain
nodes.subtitle: journal/hash.rs
nodes.summary: Computes the per-event SHA-256 over prev_hash plus canonical JSON of payload, work item, change, actor and cost, and the streaming replay digest over decision lines only. Pinned test vectors fix the byte layout.

nodes.label: Journal reader
nodes.subtitle: journal/reader.rs
nodes.summary: Replays a run: checks each line's schema, version, run id, prev_hash and recomputed hash, and returns the events, head hash, replay digest and completeness — or the first line's error and no events at all.

nodes.label: Run index
nodes.subtitle: journal/index.rs
nodes.summary: One JSON file per work item, named by the SHA-256 of its id, listing that item's run ids in recorded order. Writes go through a temp-file rename under an fs4 file lock, so concurrent writers lose no run.

nodes.label: Schema validator
nodes.subtitle: journal/schema.rs
nodes.summary: Compiles the checked-in event schema once per process and validates each serialised event, returning one reason per problem with its JSON path.

nodes.label: runs/
nodes.subtitle: <state>/runs/<run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: The journal files, moved from `buffer/` to `runs/`. Each run is its own hash chain starting from genesis; a run id that is not a safe single path component is refused.

nodes.label: index/
nodes.subtitle: <state>/index/<sha256>.json
nodes.summary: Per-work-item run lists, plus a `.lock` sibling per index file. Created only when a journal carries a work item.

nodes.label: event.schema.json
nodes.subtitle: draft 2020-12
nodes.summary: The contract every event must satisfy: envelope fields, the ten event types, and the conditional rules — a harness actor needs a model, a blocked state change needs a cause, only observed findings may name a verifier.

nodes.label: Decision 0005
nodes.subtitle: the factory domain model
nodes.summary: Amended to add the `system` actor kind, to name the review-answer and review-decision event types, and to say the replay digest — not the chain hash — is what proves a replay.

nodes.label: CI checkpoint job
nodes.subtitle: .github/workflows/ci.yml
nodes.summary: Uploads the checkpoint evidence from `<state>/runs` instead of `<state>/buffer`, matching the new layout.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The checkpoint runner is the main producer: one verification event per task and one checkpoint-complete event, now through the validating writer.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The review run writes review-answer and review-decision events through the same writer.

edges.label: validate(event)
edges.summary: Every draft is serialised and validated before the line is written; a failure returns the reasons and writes nothing.

edges.label: event_hash(HashInput)
edges.summary: The writer computes the next link from the previous hash and the draft's hashed parts.

edges.label: record_run(work_item, run)
edges.summary: The first accepted event records the run in its work item's index before any journal line lands; a failed index update refuses the event.

edges.label: one JSON line
edges.summary: Appends the validated event as one JSON line with a trailing newline.

edges.label: temp file + rename
edges.summary: Reads, appends and rewrites the index under a file lock, renaming a temporary file over the target so a reader never sees a half-written index.

edges.label: read_to_string
edges.summary: Reads the run's journal file and checks every line in order.

edges.label: validate(line)
edges.summary: Each line is validated against the same schema the writer used, so a hand-edited line is refused even when its hash was recomputed.

edges.label: event_hash + ReplayDigest
edges.summary: Recomputes each link and accumulates the replay digest over the decision fields.

edges.label: serialised shape
edges.summary: The Rust types and the schema describe the same envelope; the schema is the contract the writer and reader both enforce.

edges.label: include_str!
edges.summary: The schema is compiled into the binary and compiled once per process.

edges.label: domain model
edges.summary: The decision record names the actor kinds, event types and the replay-digest rule the model implements.

edges.label: checkpoint-evidence
edges.summary: CI uploads the runs directory as the checkpoint evidence artifact.

views.title: Journal at a glance
views.summary: The engine writes through one validating writer into a run's journal file, with a per-work-item index beside it; the reader replays the same file and checks every link.

views.title: Inside the journal module
views.summary: The five modules the journal split into, and the schema they share.

children.title: The write path
children.summary: Validate, hash, index, then append — in that order, so a refused event leaves nothing behind.

children.title: The read path
children.summary: Every line is checked against the schema, the run id, the previous hash and its own recomputed hash before any event is returned.
